description: We are an innovative team which aims to bring a playful spirit to the competition through our groundbreaking artistic creations, allowing the user to exercise his creativity and get involved in real scenarios.
summary: Here at GHMMY we competed at the Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge and created an interactive roblox game, targeted for audiences of 7-12 years old. Our game is designed for children with learning disabilities, making use of solely symbolic means of transferring educational information about Mars and space, as understanding text is often a big barrier towards them. Thus, these children get to joyfully experience the challenges of surviving in a Martian space base while also developing their interests about space and feel included in the international community of space enthusiasts.
details: Our project provides a way for children who don't understand english or have learning disabilities and neurodevelopmental disorders to experience the joy of exploring space and educating themselves about it. The game is hosted on the roblox platform, thus being publicly available to play for any player at any time. Its benefits are its inclusiveness and creative way of surpassing the language barriers that may otherwise keep potential future astronauts out of the picture. Its purpose is to ensure those children to have equal chances and make them feel included. We used the Roblox Studio, coded on the integrated language of Luau, created 3d assets or utilised premade templates. It is the first game of its kind.
projectRefs: Study about positive effects of symbols on learning
